scope: Fix CFS corruption with sched_walt on 7.3: WALT load balancing migrated proxy-execution donors / mutex-blocked tasks
root_cause: android18-7.3 has CONFIG_SCHED_PROXY_EXEC=y: a mutex-blocked task stays queued and can be rq->donor (its scheduling context runs the lock owner). Native can_migrate_task() refuses task_is_blocked(); WALT (written for 6.12 without proxy exec) only skipped task_on_cpu(), so walt_newidle_balance -> walt_lb_pull_tasks detached the donor. The source CPU then ticked/updated an entity whose cfs_rq belonged to another rq: lockdep_assert_rq_held in update_se/update_load_avg/cpuacct, h_curr mismatch in put_prev_task_fair, Oops in pick_next_entity.
how_found: Reproduced at ~40% with 20 s sustained mixed load with both policies on walt (not governor-specific; schedutil mix and failed waltgov_init were red herrings: failed init alone 0/2)
Disabling the MVP replace hook did not help (1/4)
Instrumented set_task_cpu never saw a running/queued task retargeted (0/13 hits, 2 reproductions)
First warning trace: CPU entering idle -> walt_newidle_balance -> walt_lb_pull_tasks -> walt_detach_task -> deactivate_task with assertion; compared against native can_migrate_task
fix: walt_proxy_pinned(): blocked_on.lock set or rq->donor -> not migratable, used by _walt_can_migrate_task (pull loops) and storage LB
active-push path additionally skips blocked tasks; stopper already requires TASK_RUNNING
__sched_proxy_exec key is unexported, so blocked_on.lock is checked directly (conservative when proxy exec is off)
result: after fix: 12/12 sustained all-walt, 4/4 mixed governors, 3/3 standard+stress (6 checks) with zero WARN/Oops
